styleLock.backgroundSystem: 两套背景严格交替，不得混用第三套：(a) 真实住宅卫浴墙角，手工抹灰墙面 #EAE3D9 带真实批刀纹与轻微色差、磨石质感地面 #CFC7BC 配 1.5mm 分缝 #BDB4A8，画内至少一处真实收边件（毛巾环、毛巾杆、地漏、淋浴屏金属边或一条标准毛巾）交代尺度；(b) 平面信息底板，暖石灰 #F4F1EC 与深炭 #2E2B27 条带交替，承载 14px 圆角白卡 #FFFFFF、浅沙图槽 #EDE7DE 与一枚暖金属 #BE9048 环形描边标签。禁止无缝白色棚拍、禁止复制粘贴的砖纹或重复物体、禁止第二支强调色、禁止把卫浴拍成泳池或温泉
styleLock.lightingSystem: 单一光源逻辑贯穿整套：4000K 柔和自然光从画外左侧低角度进入作为左前主光，右侧由抹灰墙做宽幅柔反弹补光，一道浅角度掠光沿拉手条、抽屉分缝与柜体底梁滑过以交代构造，接触阴影真实落在同一方向，柜脚与壁挂箱体都不得悬空漂浮；镜面前灯带只允许作为镜面镜头内的局部补光层、不改变全片主光向；全片只允许这一个光向，禁止暖色灯具作为主光、禁止湿区内出现灯具、插座、开关或裸露线缆、禁止任何带电部件与水或蒸汽直接接触的画面、禁止逆光剪影与硬长投影
styleLock.surfaceSystem: 产品表面按参考图本真呈现：门板与抽屉面 #A2A6AB 为哑光漆面，带真实微橘皮与指痕反光衰减；柜体与侧板 #F6F4F0 为平整饰面，只做饰面呈现、不写板材树种与等级；一体台面与盆体 #EFEEE9 为细晶面（受控长条高光、非镜面反射）；细长横竖拉手段、柜底横贯饰带与四支收分细脚同为暖金属饰面 #B0813C，用掠射光读出演伸方向，只以色值与形态描述、不写金属与镀层种类；镜面为真实反射（只反射对面抹灰墙与毛巾，绝不反照人物），镜面灯带读为两道柔和扩散光面而非灯珠串；地面为哑光磨石 #CFC7BC
styleLock.typography: 现代几何无衬线中文字体单一家族，标题用 medium 一档、正文与标签用 regular 一档，字距偏紧；标题一至两行 34-42pt，浅色场用 #3B3833、深炭场用 #F4F1EC，标题下方一枚 3px 暖金属 #BE9048 短横条（非细线）；副标 17-20pt、标签 12-14pt；所有画面内文字一律以 「」 包裹的占位符出现，禁止复刻源页文案；每屏渲染字符不超 50，禁止密集正文与小字条款
styleLock.iconSystem: 1.6 单位单线图标，圆头收尾，坐在 2px 环形描边框内：浅色场只用暖金属 #BE9048，深炭场只用 #F4F1EC，每屏最多六枚、成组时环径一致；禁止实心圆片图标、禁止方形描边框、禁止等轴测插画、禁止立体徽章与长投影、禁止混合线宽
styleLock.presentationRules: 整套内保持与参考图完全一致的门扇数量与左右宽度分配（两扇门夹一列三格抽屉）、横向抽屉拉手条与竖向门拉手条的方向与位置、四支收分细脚的位置与外撇角度、柜底横贯金属饰带、一体台面前沿的薄边轮廓与后沿低挡水沿、长方盆在台面内的偏置方向与四角小圆角、单柄高身龙头的开孔与出水口朝向、隐藏式下水口的凹位形式，以及可选镜面的三种轮廓与灯带布置；壁挂镜柜必须画出真实固定点，绝不悬空；实景镜头竖线全部校正、磨石分缝透视一致；每幅实景都放一件真实五金或洁具（毛巾环、毛巾杆、地漏、淋浴屏边、标准毛巾）作尺度锚点；水只允许以盆内一层浅水膜或单颗水珠出现，绝不把水泼在地面、台面或柜脚周围做演示，绝不以积水浸泡柜底作测试；人物只允许无面部、无全身的匿名手部以下裁切，且不得有儿童攀爬拉开抽屉；镜面起雾与除雾只以镜面对比呈现，不得画出加热线路、触点或蒸汽冲刷电器件

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent warm neutral light-luxury bathroom vanity ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page set; fixed palette of warm limestone info field #F4F1EC, deep charcoal dark field and band #2E2B27, graphite type #3B3833 and one warm metal accent #BE9048, with the product's own surfaces held constant as matte lacquered door and drawer fronts #A2A6AB, plain-finish carcass and side panels #F6F4F0, fine-grain one-piece counter and basin #EFEEE9, and slim pull bars, base rail and tapered legs all rendered as warm metal finish #B0813C by hex value only with no alloy or plating named; neutral temperature throughout, no cool clinical cast, no sepia filter; background system alternates only a real residential bathroom corner in hand-troweled plaster wall #EAE3D9 with visible trowel variation over honed speckled stone floor #CFC7BC with 1.5mm joints #BDB4A8, where every joint line stays geometrically consistent and at least one real fitting (towel ring, towel bar, floor drain, shower screen edge or standard towel) anchors scale, and a flat infographic field of warm limestone #F4F1EC and deep charcoal #2E2B27 bands carrying 14px rounded-corner cards #FFFFFF, one low-chroma image well #EDE7DE and a 2px warm-metal ring-outlined label pill; never a white cyclorama, never a repeated tile or stone motif, never a second accent hue; lighting system is one 4000K soft daylight key entering low from camera left through an off-frame window with a wide bounce off the plaster on the shadow side, one shallow grazing pass along every pull bar, drawer seam and the base rail, honest single-direction contact shadows so the four legs and the wall-hung cabinet never float, the same single light direction reused in every frame, mirror light bands allowed only as local fill inside mirror frames and never overriding the key, no lamp, socket, switch or bare cable shown inside the wet zone or touching water or steam; surface system renders matte lacquered fronts #A2A6AB with real micro orange-peel falloff, plain carcass panels #F6F4F0 with no board grade or species named, fine-grain counter and basin #EFEEE9 with one controlled elongated specular streak rather than a mirror, warm metal #B0813C read with raking light, mirror faces that reflect only the opposite plaster wall and a towel and never a person; typography is one modern geometric sans-serif family at medium headline and regular body weights with tightened tracking, headline 34-42pt in #3B3833 on light and #F4F1EC on charcoal with one 3px warm-metal bar #BE9048 beneath, subtitle 17-20pt, labels 12-14pt, every in-image string a 「」-wrapped placeholder, under 50 rendered characters per screen, no dense body copy; icon system is 1.6-unit monoline pictograms with rounded caps seated inside a 2px ring outline in warm metal #BE9048 on light fields and #F4F1EC on charcoal fields, maximum six per screen with identical ring diameters, no filled discs, no square frames, no isometric illustration, no 3D badges, no mixed stroke weights; product presentation keeps the identical door-leaf count and width split around the three-drawer column, the horizontal drawer bars versus vertical door bars, the four tapered leg positions and splay, the full-width base rail, the thin counter front edge and low rear splash rim, the offset rectangular basin outline with its small corner radius, the tall single-lever mixer position, the recessed concealed drain detail and the three optional mirror outlines with their light-band layout, all verticals corrected, stone joint geometry consistent, scale anchored by a real fitting, water allowed only as a shallow film inside the bowl or one droplet, never poured or pooled against a cabinet base, wall-mounted cabinets always drawn with their visible fixings, fog versus clear shown only as a mirror-surface comparison with no wiring or live part in steam, no child on any open drawer;
